description: Source code for handling pod failure policies in Kubernetes jobs, including matching failed pods against failure rules based on exit codes and conditions.

methods.name: matchPodFailurePolicy
methods.description: Determines how a failed pod matches failure policy rules, returning a message, a boolean for backoff counting, and the matched action.

methods.name: matchOnExitCodes
methods.description: Finds a container status matching specific exit code requirements.

methods.name: matchOnPodConditions
methods.description: Checks if pod conditions match specified patterns.

methods.name: getMatchingContainerFromList
methods.description: Returns the first container status in the list that matches exit code requirements.

methods.name: isOnExitCodesOperatorMatching
methods.description: Checks if an exit code matches the operator condition (In or NotIn).
